fusions.name: Cable Swing
fusions.desc: A winch cable swings you onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away, where a blow deals 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Longer Lever
fusions.desc: Jams a pry bar into the target's guard and hauls on it, which deals 32 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest-Plate Drumming
fusions.desc: Your attack speed rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are drawn onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ratchet Grip
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
